name: The Convergence
description: Total conversion for ELDEN RING with Shadow of the Erdtree

notes.title: Install 1.17 and launch vanilla once
notes.body: Install ELDEN RING via Steam, then start the vanilla game once so its Proton prefix exists. The installer refuses to run without it.

notes.title: Stay on build 25827938
notes.body: In the game's Steam properties choose Only update this game when I launch it. This pack is built for 1.17; a newer build may break the mod.

notes.title: Shadow of the Erdtree is required
notes.body: Convergence needs the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Buy and install it in Steam before installing this pack.

notes.title: Play offline
notes.body: Launch through the ModSync shortcut. Playing online with mods can get the account banned; the launcher starts the game with online disabled.

notes.title: Saves are separate
notes.body: The mod uses ER0000.convergence.sl2. Vanilla ER0000.sl2 and Steam Cloud are untouched. v1 does not transfer saves between machines.

preconditions.title: Proton prefix exists
preconditions.hint: Launch the vanilla game once from Steam.

preconditions.title: Shadow of the Erdtree is installed
preconditions.hint: Buy and install the DLC in Steam, then confirm here.
